cn: 恰好是，正是；甚至；十足的；特有的

example.en: He died in this very room.
example.cn: 他就是在这个房间里去世的。

enDef: a copy of a film or television programme, or a series of events, recorded on videotape

example.en: Let’s stay at home and watch a video.
example.cn: 我们待在家里看录像吧。

enDef: a game in which two teams use their hands to hit a ball over a high net

example.en: I have a volleyball , But he one.
example.cn: 我没有排球，但他有一个。

enDef: the sounds that you make when you speak, or the ability to make these sounds

example.en: He recognized her voice instantly.
example.cn: 他立刻听出了她的声音。

enDef: a plant that is eaten raw or cooked, such as a cabbage, a carrot, or peas

example.cn: 新鲜果蔬

cn: 访问者，参观者；视察者；候鸟

example.en: Times Square attracts more than 30 million visitors annually.
example.cn: 时代广场每年吸引三千多万游客。

值；价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义
enDef: the amount of money that something is worth

example.en: the nutritional value of cereal
example.cn: 谷类食物的营养价值

cn: [车辆] 车辆；工具；交通工具；运载工具；传播媒介；媒介物
enDef: a machine with an engine that is used to take people or things from one place to another, such as a car, bus, or truck

example.en: a description of the stolen vehicle
example.cn: 对被盗车辆的描述

enDef: a small wooden musical instrument that you hold under your chin and play by pulling a bow(= special stick ) across the strings

cn: 词汇； 词汇量； 词汇表
enDef: all the words that someone knows or uses

example.en: Teachers were impressed by his vocabulary.
example.cn: 他的词汇量给老师们留下了深刻的印象。

enDef: an occasion when someone goes to spend time in a place or goes to see a person

example.en: We’re just here on a short visit.
example.cn: 我们只在这儿作短暂逗留。

enDef: a holiday, or time spent not working

example.en: We’re planning a vacation in Europe.
example.cn: 我们正计划去欧洲度假。

enDef: a situation in which you win a battle, game, election, or dispute

example.en: Union leaders are heading for victory in their battle over workplace rights.
example.cn: 工会领袖们在争取工作场所权利的斗争中正迈向胜利。

cn: 考虑， 认为； 观察， 看
enDef: to watch a television programme, film etc

example.en: an opportunity to view the film before it goes on general release
example.cn: 在影片公映之前观影的机会

enDef: to offer to do something without expecting any reward, often something that other people do not want to do

example.en: I volunteered my services as a driver.
example.cn: 我主动提出来当司机。

enDef: a very small town in the countryside

example.en: a little fishing village
example.cn: 一座小渔村

enDef: a word or group of words that describes an action, experience, or state, such as ‘come’, ‘see’, and ‘put on’

example.en: The word is an adjunct of that verb.
example.cn: 这个词是那个动词的修饰语。

enDef: involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc

example.en: the increase in violent crime
example.cn: 暴力犯罪的增多

cn: 观察者；观看者；观众；[仪] 指示器
enDef: someone who watches television

example.en: The new series has gone down well with viewers.
example.cn: 这个新的电视系列片很受观众欢迎。

enDef: behaviour that is intended to hurt other people physically

example.en: There is too much sex and violence on TV these days.
example.cn: 如今电视上性爱和暴力场面太多。

enDef: a sour-tasting liquid made from malt or wine that is used to improve the taste of food or to preserve it

example.en: With vinegar and brown paper.
example.cn: 用醋和棕色纸张包扎。

cn: 有效的；有根据的；合法的；正当的
enDef: a valid ticket, document, or agreement is legally or officially acceptable

example.en: a valid credit card
example.cn: 有效信用卡

enDef: someone who has been attacked, robbed, or murdered

example.en: The victim received head injuries from which she died a week later.
example.cn: 受害人头部受伤，一周后死亡。

cn: 视觉的，视力的；栩栩如生的
enDef: relating to seeing

example.en: Artists translate their ideas into visual images.
example.cn: 画家把自己的思想转换成视觉画面。

enDef: to show which person or party you want, or whether you support a plan, by marking a piece of paper, raising your hand etc

example.en: In 1918 British women got the right to vote.
example.cn: 1918年，英国妇女获得了选举权。

enDef: worth a lot of money

example.en: a valuable painting
example.cn: 一幅名贵的画

enDef: travelling through a place on the way to another place

example.en: We flew to Athens via Paris.
example.cn: 我们经由巴黎飞往雅典。

enDef: a mountain with a large hole at the top, through which lava(= very hot liquid rock ) is sometimes forced out

example.en: Pompeii was destroyed when the volcano erupted in 79 AD.
example.cn: 庞贝城于公元79年在火山爆发中毁灭。

enDef: a vacant seat, building, room or piece of land is empty and available for someone to use

example.en: Only a few apartments were still vacant.
example.cn: 只有几套公寓仍然空着。

enDef: an area of lower land between two lines of hills or mountains, usually with a river flowing through it

example.en: the San Fernando Valley
example.cn: 圣费尔南多山谷

enDef: if there are various things, there are several different types of that thing

example.en: The jacket is available in various colours.
example.cn: 这种夹克有好多种颜色可选。

cn: 重大的， 生死攸关的
enDef: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important

example.en: The port is vital to supply relief to millions of drought victims.
example.cn: 这个港口至关重要，给数百万旱灾民提供救济物资。

enDef: vivid memories, dreams, descriptions etc are so clear that they seem real

example.en: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
example.cn: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

enDef: to disobey or do something against an official agreement, law, principle etc

example.en: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
example.cn: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

enDef: a very small living thing that causes infectious illnesses

example.en: children infected with the Aids virus
example.cn: 感染艾滋病病毒的儿童

enDef: unclear because someone does not give enough detailed information or does not say exactly what they mean

example.en: The governor gave only a vague outline of his tax plan.
example.cn: 州长只是含糊地大致说了一下他的税务计划。

enDef: a substance used to give a special taste to ice cream, cakes etc, made from the beans of a tropical plant

example.en: I added a dollop of vanilla ice cream to the pie.
example.cn: 我在馅饼中加了一块香草冰淇淋。

enDef: a copy of something that has been changed so that it is slightly different

example.en: the human version of mad cow disease
example.cn: 疯牛病的人类变体

cn: 徒劳的；自负的；无结果的；无用的
enDef: someone who is vain is too proud of their good looks, abilities, or position – used to show disapproval

example.en: Men can be just as vain as women.
example.cn: 男人有时会和女人一样虚荣。

enDef: a type of telephone that allows you to see the person you are talking to on a screen

example.en: Perhaps as soon as 2007, these assistants will hover over an astronaut's shoulder, serving as an all-in-one PDA, videophone, and air monitor.
example.cn: 最快到2007年，这类助理型机器人就会出现在宇航员的箭头，它能用做PDA、可视电话并监测空气。

enDef: a container used to put flowers in or for decoration

example.en: ...a vase of red roses.
example.cn: …一个插着红玫瑰的花瓶。

enDef: a bad habit

example.en: Smoking is my only vice.
example.cn: 吸烟是我唯一的恶习。

cn: 自愿的；志愿的；自发的；故意的
enDef: done willingly and without being forced

example.en: Workers are being encouraged to take voluntary redundancy.
example.cn: 工人被鼓励主动离职。

enDef: a long journey in a ship or spacecraft

example.en: The voyage from England to India used to take six months.
example.cn: 过去从英格兰到印度要航行六个月。

enDef: an official mark put on your passport that gives you permission to temporarily enter or leave a foreign country

example.en: I was still in New York, trying to get a visa to visit Russia.
example.cn: 我仍在纽约，正在办理去俄罗斯的签证。

enDef: a piece of underwear without sleeves that you wear on the top half of your body

example.en: a bulletproof vest
example.cn: 防弹背心

enDef: a type of thing, such as a plant or animal, that is different from others in the same group

example.en: West Hampstead has a variety of good stores and supermarkets.
example.cn: 西汉普斯特德有几家不同的高品质商店和超市。

cn: 垂直的， 直立的； 纵向的
enDef: pointing up in a line that forms an angle of 90˚ with a flat surface

example.en: a vertical line
example.cn: 垂直线

enDef: moral goodness of character and behaviour

example.en: Women have often been used as symbols of virtue.
example.cn: 女性常被用作美德的象征。

enDef: someone who lives in a village

example.en: Soon the villagers couldn't afford to buy food for themselves.
example.cn: 很快村民们就买不起吃的东西了。

cn: 广阔的；巨大的；大量的；巨额的
enDef: extremely large

example.en: The refugees come across the border in vast numbers.
example.cn: 大量难民涌过边境。

enDef: the meat of a calf(= a young cow )

example.en: ...a veal cutlet.
example.cn: …一块小牛排。

cn: 小提琴演奏者，小提琴家
enDef: someone who plays the violin

example.en: Rose's father was a talented violinist.
example.cn: 罗斯的父亲是一位天才的小提琴手。

enDef: to disappear suddenly, especially in a way that cannot be easily explained

example.en: My keys were here a minute ago but now they’ve vanished.
example.cn: 我的钥匙刚刚还在这里，现在却不翼而飞了。

enDef: almost

example.en: Virtually all the children come to school by bus.
example.cn: 几乎所有的孩子都乘公交车上学。

enDef: the distance it is possible to see, especially when this is affected by weather conditions

example.en: Visibility on the roads is down to 20 metres due to heavy fog.
example.cn: 道路能见度因浓雾降至20米。

enDef: something that is visible can be seen

example.en: The comet is visible to the naked eye (= can be seen without using special equipment ).
example.cn: 这颗彗星肉眼看得见。

enDef: if several things of the same type vary, they are all different from each other

example.en: Test scores vary from school to school.
example.cn: 测验成绩各校不同。

enDef: in a very important or necessary way

example.en: A sensible diet is vitally important if you want to remain in good health.
example.cn: 如想保持健康，合理的饮食十分重要。

enDef: made, done, seen etc on the Internet or on a computer, rather than in the real world

example.en: The website allows you to take a virtual tour of the art gallery.
example.cn: 这个网站可让你对美术馆作一番虚拟参观。

cn: 观点， 看法， 见解
enDef: a particular way of thinking about a problem or subject

example.en: Different viewpoints produce different images.
example.cn: 角度不同，产生的画面也不同。

enDef: to treat someone unfairly because you do not like them, their beliefs, or the race they belong to

example.en: The men claim they have been victimized because of their political activity.
example.cn: 那些人声称他们因为自己的政治活动而受到了迫害。

enDef: a space that is completely empty of all gas, especially one from which all the air has been taken away

example.en: His presence should fill the power vacuum that has been developing over the past few days.
example.cn: 他的出现应该能填补过去几天中形成的权力空缺。

enDef: a vehicle used especially for carrying goods, which is smaller than a truck and has a roof and usually no windows at the sides

example.en: a delivery van
example.cn: 运货车

enDef: a mass of very small drops of a liquid which float in the air, for example because the liquid has been heated

example.en: water vapour
example.cn: 水蒸气

enDef: likely to change often

example.en: Expect variable cloudiness and fog tomorrow.
example.cn: 预计明天多云有雾，天气多变。

enDef: a difference between similar things, or a change from the usual amount or form of something

example.en: Most of his poems are variations on the theme of love.
example.cn: 他的大部分诗作都是有关爱情主题的形式不同的作品。

enDef: the speed of something that is moving in a particular direction

example.en: the velocity of light
example.cn: 光速

enDef: a new business activity that involves taking risks

example.en: When darkness fell, he would venture out.
example.cn: 天黑以后，他就会壮着胆子出去。

enDef: to state that something is true

example.en: His statement was verified by several witnesses.
example.cn: 他的说法得到了几位证人的证实。

enDef: a ship or large boat

example.en: a fishing vessel
example.cn: 渔船

enDef: someone who has been a soldier, sailor etc in a war

example.en: a Vietnam veteran
example.cn: 越战老兵

enDef: if something vibrates, or if you vibrate it, it shakes quickly and continuously with very small movements

example.en: The floor was vibrating to the beat of the music.
example.cn: 地板随着音乐的节奏在颤动。

enDef: a plant with small dark purple flowers, or sometimes white or yellow ones

example.en: She inhaled the violet perfume, saying “How sweet!”
example.cn: 她一边闻紫罗兰的芳香， 一边说“好香啊！”

enDef: the ability to see

example.en: She suffered temporary loss of vision after being struck on the head.
example.cn: 她头部受撞击以后出现暂时性失明。

enDef: a chemical substance in food that is necessary for good health

example.en: Try to eat foods that are rich in vitamins and minerals.
example.cn: 尽量吃富含维生素和矿物质的食物。

enDef: a unit for measuring the force of an electric current

example.en: That is one electron volt.
example.cn: 就是一单位的电子伏特。

enDef: electrical force measured in volts

example.en: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
example.cn: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

enDef: the amount of sound produced by a television, radio etc

example.en: the volume of trade
example.cn: 贸易量

enDef: a particular type of work that you feel is right for you

example.en: At 17 she found her true vocation as a writer.
example.cn: 17岁时她找到了自己真正的使命——当一名作家。

enDef: (of a liquid 液体) thick and sticky; not flowing freely

example.en: As the liquid cools, it becomes viscous.
example.cn: 这液体冷却后会变黏稠。

enDef: one of the human speech sounds that you make by letting your breath flow out without closing any part of your mouth or throat

example.en: Each language has a different vowel system.
example.cn: 每种语言都有不同的元音系统。

enDef: to cover something with a veil

example.en: A black kerchief modestly veiled her hair.
example.cn: 一条黑色头巾端庄地裹着她的头发。

enDef: very unkind in a way that is intended to hurt someone’s feelings or make their character seem bad

example.en: Sarah can be quite vicious at times.
example.cn: 萨拉有时相当狠毒。

cn: 活力； 生机， 元气
enDef: great energy and eagerness to do things

example.en: Despite her eighty years, Elsie was full of vitality.
example.cn: 尽管已80岁了，埃尔茜依然充满活力。

cn: 口头的； 用言辞的， 用文字的； 动词的
enDef: spoken rather than written

example.en: verbal skills
example.cn: 语言技能

enDef: the Roman goddess of love
made of velvet

example.en: velvet curtains/cushions
example.cn: 天鹅绒窗帘/坐垫

enDef: a serious promise

example.en: Jim made a vow that he would find his wife’s killer.
example.cn: 吉姆发誓要找到杀害他妻子的凶手。

enDef: a quantity such as force that has a direction as well as size

example.en: Acceleration and velocity are both vectors.
example.cn: 加速度和速度都是矢量。

enDef: words arranged in the form of poetry

example.en: a book of comic verse
example.cn: 一本滑稽诗集

example.en: So that satisfies the definition of validity.
example.cn: 所以这满足了有效性的定义。

enDef: someone who does not eat meat or fish

example.en: Our youngest daughter is a vegetarian.
example.cn: 我们的小女儿是个素食主义者。

enDef: an action that breaks a law, agreement, principle etc

example.en: human rights violations
example.cn: 违反人权

cn: 脆弱的, 易受影响的
enDef: someone who is vulnerable can be easily harmed or hurt

example.en: He took advantage of me when I was at my most vulnerable.
example.cn: 他在我最脆弱的时候利用了我。

enDef: to form a picture of someone or something in your mind

example.en: I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
example.cn: 我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

enDef: teaching or relating to the skills you need to do a particular job

example.en: vocational qualifications
example.cn: 职业资格

enDef: to let fresh air into a room, building etc

example.en: Ventilate the room properly when stripping paint.
example.cn: 在刮漆的时候要适当地使房间通风。

example.en: In this example, the validation fails.
example.cn: 在这个示例中，验证失败。

enDef: a plant with long thin stems that attach themselves to other plants, trees, buildings etc

example.en: Ivy is a type of vine.
example.cn: 常青藤是一种藤本植物。

enDef: the amount by which two or more things are different or by which they change

example.en: a price variance of 5%
example.cn: 5%的价格差异

enDef: in the area around a particular place

example.en: The stolen car was found in the vicinity of the station.
example.cn: 被盗汽车在车站附近被发现。

enDef: (of a contract, an agreement etc.) not valid or legal

example.en: The agreement was declared void.
example.cn: 该协议已宣布无效。

enDef: one of the tubes which carries blood to your heart from other parts of your body

example.en: the pulmonary vein
example.cn: 肺静脉

enDef: physical or mental energy and determination

example.en: He began working with renewed vigour.
example.cn: 他以更加旺盛的精力开始工作。

enDef: a roof or ceiling that consists of several arches that are joined together, especially in a church

example.en: ...the vault of a great cathedral.
example.cn: 一座大教堂的拱顶

enDef: to protect a person or animal from a disease by giving them a vaccine

example.en: All children should be vaccinated against measles.
example.cn: 所有儿童都应该接种麻疹疫苗。

cn: 内脏的， 腑脏的； 出自内心的， 发自肺腑的
enDef: visceral beliefs and attitudes are the result of strong feelings rather than careful thought

example.en: his visceral hatred of the ruling class
example.cn: 他对统治阶级发自肺腑的仇恨

enDef: a refusal to give official permission for something, or the right to refuse to give such permission

example.en: The Senate had a sufficient majority to override the presidential veto (= not accept his refusal ).
example.cn: 参议院有足够的多数票可以推翻总统的否决。

enDef: a part of a tube or pipe that opens and shuts like a door to control the flow of liquid, gas, air etc passing through it

example.en: heart valves
example.cn: 心脏瓣膜

enDef: having many different uses

example.en: The potato is an extremely versatile vegetable.
example.cn: 马铃薯是一种用途极广的蔬菜。

enDef: not having or showing good taste; not polite, elegant or well behaved

example.en: vulgar behaviour
example.cn: 粗俗的行为

enDef: someone who has never had sex

example.en: I was a virgin until I was thirty years old.
example.cn: 我到30岁时还是个处女。

enDef: a hole or pipe through which gases, liquid etc can enter or escape from an enclosed space or container

example.en: a blocked air vent
example.cn: 堵塞的通风口

enDef: a house that you use or rent while you are on holiday

example.en: We rented a holiday villa in Spain.
example.cn: 我们在西班牙租了一座假日别墅。

cn: 喜欢畅所欲言的，直言不讳的；嗓音的，发声的
enDef: relating to the voice or to singing

example.en: vocal music
example.cn: 声乐

enDef: an edge or rim; margin

example.en: They set up camp on the verge of the desert.
example.cn: 他们在沙漠边缘扎下了营地。

enDef: a violent or harmful action that someone does to punish someone for harming them or their family

example.en: a desire for vengeance
example.cn: 复仇的愿望

cn: 裁定； 定论， 判断性意见
enDef: an official decision made in a court of law, especially about whether someone is guilty of a crime or how a death happened

example.en: The verdict was ‘not guilty’.
example.cn: 裁决为“无罪”。

enDef: used to show that two people or teams are competing against each other in a game or court case

example.en: the New York Knicks versus the LA Lakers
example.cn: 纽约尼克斯队对洛杉矶湖人队

enDef: plants in general

example.en: Lefkas has an abundance of lush green vegetation.
example.cn: 莱夫卡斯有葱郁茂盛的植被。

cn: 与…相对， 与…相比；以…为对手， 对

enDef: too much pride in yourself, so that you are always thinking about yourself and your appearance

example.en: Sabrina had none of the vanity so often associated with beautiful women.
example.cn: 萨布里娜没有一点漂亮女人经常会有的那种虚荣。

example.en: This system traps the gasoline vapor escaping from the fuel tank and carburetor .
example.cn: 这个系统能收集从燃油箱和化油器泄漏出来的汽油蒸气。

enDef: a substance which contains a weak form of the bacteria or virus that causes a disease and is used to protect people from that disease

example.en: a polio vaccine
example.cn: 小儿麻痹症疫苗

cn: 反过来也是如此，反之亦然
enDef: used to say that the opposite of a situation you have just described is also true

example.en: The boys may refuse to play with the girls, and vice versa.
example.cn: 男孩可能拒绝和女孩玩耍，反之亦然。

enDef: a living creature that has a backbone

example.en: Dead bodies of vertebrate in the field should not be collected or closely examined.
example.cn: 不要太接近脊椎动物的尸体或收集它们作样本。

cn: 空气流通； 通风设备， 通风方法

example.en: I see no ventilation to speak of, none from a window or a ventilator at least.
example.cn: 我看不到通风设备，连窗户或至少一个通风扇也没有。

example.en: In our world, not only do we have variability, we've got unpredictability.
example.cn: 在我们的世界不仅有可变性，还有不可预见性。

enDef: to check someone’s past activities, relationships etc in order to make sure that person is suitable for a particular job, especially an important one

example.en: All candidates are carefully vetted by Central Office.
example.cn: 所有候选人都由总部仔细审查。

enDef: a professional judgment about how much something is worth

example.en: The property has a valuation of $1.6 billion.
example.cn: 那处房地产估价为16亿美元。

enDef: relating to the medical care and treatment of sick animals

example.en: veterinary medicine
example.cn: 兽医学

cn: 法律规定的； 既定的
enDef: vested rights, powers, property etc belong to you and cannot be removed

example.en: Shareholders have a vested right to 10% per annum.
example.cn: 股东享有每年10%分红的既定权利。

enDef: someone who is trained to give medical care and treatment to sick animals

example.en: Include your ferret's medical records and veterinarian information in the package.
example.cn: 救济包里面记得包含貂儿的医疗记录和兽医的信息。

enDef: a place where an organized meeting, concert etc takes place

example.en: The first thing to do is book a venue.
example.cn: 首先要做的是预订一个会场。

cn: 振动的； 活泼的， 充满生气的； 兴奋的
enDef: full of activity or energy in a way that is exciting and attractive

example.en: Hong Kong is a vibrant, fascinating city.
example.cn: 香港是座富有活力的迷人城市。

enDef: to defeat someone or something completely

example.en: A happy ending is only possible because the hero has first vanquished the dragons.
example.cn: 只有主人公先把那些恶龙制服，快乐的结局才有可能。

enDef: something that is slightly different from the usual form of something

example.en: Note that you must use the same variant of this option for all compiler runs related to the same project.
example.cn: 注意，对于所有运行的与同一个项目相关的编译器，必须使用这个选项的相同变体。

enDef: consisting of or including many different kinds of things or people, especially in a way that seems interesting

example.en: a varied diet
example.cn: 丰富多样的饮食

cn: 感情强烈的；热烈的；(人)有强烈感情的
enDef: showing very strong feelings or opinions

example.en: She suddenly became very vehement and agitated, jumping around and shouting.
example.cn: 她突然变得十分激动和不安，四处暴跳并大喊大叫。

enDef: to honour or respect someone or something because they are old, holy, or connected with the past

example.en: a symbol of Arab courage, to be venerated for generations
example.cn: 受到世代尊崇的阿拉伯人勇气的象征

cn: 空位， 空房间； 空缺， 空职； 无主意， 空虚， 茫然若失
enDef: a job that is available for someone to start doing

example.en: There are still two vacancies on the school board.
example.cn: 学校董事会还有两个职位空缺。

example.en: Prepare - Research what you want to sell using Completed Listings. Have credit card and bank information ready for verification.
example.cn: 准备-通过调查已经发布的广告确认你究竟要卖什么，拥有供查证的信用卡和银行信息。

cn: 有毒的； 分泌毒液的； 恶意的， 狠毒的
enDef: full of hatred or anger

example.en: Lisa shot him a venomous glance.
example.cn: 莉萨恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼。

enDef: to make someone feel annoyed or worried

example.en: It vexed me to think of others gossiping behind my back.
example.cn: 想到别人在我背后说闲话让我很恼火。

enDef: able to continue to live or to develop into a living thing

example.en: viable seeds
example.cn: 可存活的种子

enDef: giving careful attention to what is happening, so that you will notice any danger or illegal activity

example.en: Please remain vigilant at all times and report anything suspicious.
example.cn: 请时刻保持警惕，有可疑情况随时报告。

enDef: to prove that someone or something is right or true

example.en: The decision to advertise has been vindicated by the fact that sales have grown.
example.cn: 销售增长的事实证明做广告宣传的决定是正确的。

cn: 糟糕透顶的， 可恶的； 恶劣的， 卑鄙的
enDef: extremely unpleasant or bad

example.en: This coffee tastes really vile.
example.cn: 这咖啡太难喝了。

enDef: a form of a language that ordinary people use, especially one that is not the official language

example.en: In some churches, they speak Latin, but in others they use the vernacular.
example.cn: 在一些教堂中，人们讲拉丁语，但在其他一些教堂中，人们使用本地话。

enDef: behaving in a very honest and moral way

example.en: a virtuous man
example.cn: 品行端正的男子

enDef: a popular and fashionable style, activity, method etc

example.en: Suntanning first came into vogue in the mid-1930s.
example.cn: 晒黑皮肤最早流行于20世纪30年代中期。

cn: (液体)易挥发的；(人)反复无常的
enDef: a volatile liquid or substance changes easily into a gas

example.en: an increasingly volatile political situation
example.cn: 日益动荡的政治局势

enDef: to bring food or drink up from your stomach out through your mouth, because you are ill

example.en: He had swallowed so much sea water he wanted to vomit.
example.cn: 他呛了这么多海水，所以想吐。

enDef: an official statement or receipt that is given to some­one to prove that their accounts are correct or that money has been paid

example.en: As a basic business voucher in the economic exchange, invoice is a primitive evidence for financial accounting and an important proof for taxation check.
example.cn: 发票作为经济交往中基本的商事凭证，是财务会计核算的原始凭证和税务稽查的重要凭据。
